headline: Anthropic's Nasdaq debut jumped 34% before giving back about half, Sky's USDS stablecoin saw a fast reserve drain after a North Korea money-laundering report, and bitcoin slipped to about $62,500 as stocks fell and the Fed leans toward another rate rise.

market.asOf: Read from CoinMarketCap coin pages around 20:00 UTC Thu 19 Nov (03:00 Bangkok Fri 20 Nov). CoinGecko showed slightly different prices and, for BTC and ETH, a different 24h direction; the moves are small either way. Use the live prices on this page.

stories.title: Anthropic jumps 34% in its Nasdaq debut, then gives back about half; crypto bets tracked it closely
stories.summary: Anthropic (ticker ANT) sold shares at $83 and first traded at $111.50 at 11:48am ET, about two hours after the market opened. It then slid, trading around $96 by mid-afternoon. Before the stock opened, crypto platforms let traders bet on its price with perpetual futures, and those prices landed within about 50 cents of the real first trade. These crypto products are not shares and carry no voting rights.
points: The first Nasdaq trade was $111.50 at 11:48am ET, 34.3% above the $83 IPO price, per StockTitan.
The stock then fell back to $93.13 by 1:20pm ET, per Forbes, and was at $96.16 (up 15.85%) on Yahoo Finance's 2:33pm ET snapshot.
One minute before the first trade, OKX's ANT perpetual was at $111.31 and trade.xyz's on Hyperliquid at $111.00; at 12:29pm ET OKX was $100.42 against $100.43 on Nasdaq, per Unchained.
The IPO sold 980 million shares at $83, raising about $81.3 billion, per crypto.news, which says the tokenized versions carry no voting or dividend rights.
US stocks fell: the Dow was down 801 points (1.60%) and the S&P 500 and Nasdaq 1.29% at 1:31pm ET, per the Korea Times.

sources.label: Forbes: shares pull back from 34% gain

stories.title: Sky's USDS stablecoin hit by a fast reserve drain after the North Korea report
stories.summary: Research firm Inca Digital reported that wallets linked to illicit activity, including North Korea, moved money through Sky's swap system, which turns USDC (a stablecoin its issuer can freeze) into DAI or USDS. Within hours, about $1.69 billion left the USDC reserve behind that system, and Sky's own SKY token fell about 26%. A stablecoin is only as safe as its reserves; a quick drain like this is the crypto version of a bank run.
points: Inca Digital traced $518 million through Sky's Peg Stability Module across 422 wallets, $101.9 million of it linked to North Korea, per CoinDesk.

About $2.7 billion of USDC sat in a single wallet tied to the module, so a freeze by Circle could lock all of it, per CoinDesk; Sky says flagged activity is under 0.06% of more than $930 billion in volume.
The module's USDC reserve fell about $1.69 billion in hours, per The Defiant.
The SKY token fell about 26% in 24 hours, per Crypto News Flash.

sources.label: CoinDesk: North Korean hackers used Sky's stablecoin system
The Defiant: Sky's USDC reserve falls $1.69B

stories.title: Bitcoin slips toward $62,000 as stocks fall and Fed officials talk up rate rises
stories.summary: Bitcoin faded through Thursday as US stocks turned lower, and is heading for a seventh straight weekly loss. Fed officials keep signalling more rate rises: higher rates make risky assets like crypto less attractive. Money is still leaving US bitcoin funds.
points: CoinDesk had bitcoin at about $62,250 at 12:19pm ET, down about 1% in 24 hours, and on track for a seventh straight weekly loss.
Fed official Barr said "We're going to need to adjust monetary policy further", per Newsquawk; Goolsbee said the Fed's job is to keep the AI boom from overheating the economy, per 104.9 The Wolf.
Before the minutes, traders priced a 94.7% chance of a quarter-point rise in December, and Fed Governor Waller said a half-point rise should be considered, per The Coin Republic.
US spot bitcoin funds lost a net $306.5 million on Wednesday 18 Nov, per Farside data reported by crypto.news. Thursday's figure is not out yet.

briefs.title: Coinbase reportedly plans its own prediction markets
briefs.summary: Coinbase aims to run its own US prediction markets in-house in the first half of 2027; it now offers them through Kalshi and would keep revenue it currently shares, per Bloomberg as reported by Investing.com. Coinbase said it had nothing new to announce.

briefs.title: SEC nominee wants full rulemaking on tokenization
briefs.summary: At a Senate hearing, SEC nominee Kristin Johnson said the SEC's September tokenization exemption should go through a full notice-and-comment process, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Strategy's STRC preferred stock below $100
briefs.summary: STRC closed at $96.19 with a yield of about 12.5%; Saylor said Strategy intends to keep buying it back below $100, after $228.1 million of buybacks from 9 to 15 Nov, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Trump Media faces up to $883.5M noteholder demand on 30 Nov
briefs.summary: The company holds about 15,649 BTC and about $393 million in cash, and its interim CEO plans to use cash and credit before selling bitcoin, per BigGo Finance.

briefs.title: Binance wins $6.5B freezing order over October hack
briefs.summary: An Abu Dhabi court granted a worldwide freezing order against the hackers behind Binance's 29 Oct breach; a 1 Dec hearing decides whether to extend it, per The Crypto Desk.

calendar.note: Barkin at 4:00pm ET per Saxo; Paulson at 6:30pm ET per The CIO Brief. Earlier today Barr said policy needs to adjust further (Newsquawk) and Goolsbee warned about the AI boom overheating the economy (104.9 The Wolf).

calendar.event: US PCE inflation (Oct), jobless claims and Q3 GDP (second estimate)
calendar.note: PCE and claims at 8:30am ET. GDP's second estimate is due the same day; the advance estimate was 3.4%, per Continuum Economics. September PCE inflation was 3.6% a year and core 3.1%; the Cleveland Fed nowcast for October core is 3.21%, per Admiral Markets. Jobless claims move to Wednesday for Thanksgiving (prior 203,000), per Xoomar. Fed Beige Book at 2:00pm ET (02:00 Thu Bangkok), per the Fed.

calendar.event: Thanksgiving: US stock market closed, then early close
calendar.note: Stocks closed Thursday and close at 1:00pm ET Friday, per Admiral Markets; crypto trades on through the holiday. The monthly bitcoin options expiry, 104,582 BTC or about $6.7 billion per Cryptoticker, settles Friday at 08:00 UTC (15:00 Bangkok).

calendar.event: Next Fed meeting and rate decision
calendar.note: Meeting 8-9 Dec, per the Fed. The October minutes showed almost all officials saw further rate rises as likely, per the Fed; before the minutes traders priced a 94.7% chance of a quarter-point rise, per The Coin Republic.
